explanation: Requested pion-channel kinematics are physically impossible: W = 1.05 GeV is below the pi+ n production threshold (approximately 1.079 GeV using physical masses). The pion EXCLURAD implementation also uses a 0.139570 GeV detected-pion mass and a 0.938272 GeV recoil-nucleon mass, implying its own approximate two-body threshold W = 1.077842 GeV. At W = 1.05 GeV the final-state center-of-mass momentum is imaginary, irrespective of Q2, cos(theta*), or phi*, so no EXCLURAD input file was generated.
